text:
maria (product_designer): quick follow-up from design review — listing small UX nits before we ship the compliance panel update. keeping it short, flagging copy + a11y + a tiny layout ask.

sam (devex): +1. can you paste the current strings so i can grep them in the UI?

maria (product_designer): sure — current audit log event text: `User updated retention policy for workspace X to 90 days (was 30)` — feels a bit noisy and inconsistent with other events. thinking: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days` or `Retention period updated: 30 → 90 days` for compactness. which format do we prefer?

ben (docs): i prefer `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days` — reads well in sentences and is search-friendly for our docs.

arjun (eng-platform): lgtm. small perf note: shorter messages mean less space in the table row, fewer wraps.

linda (security): also call out if the event includes who made the change and via UI/API. audit needs: `by <actor>` or `via API` when applicable. e.g., `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by maria (UI)`.

maria (product_designer): good call. suggested canonical event string: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by maria (UI)`. i'll update mockups.

ethan (a11y): accessibility nit — the retention dropdown currently uses position-only labels: `30, 60, 90` without units. Screen reader reads just numbers. please append units in the visible label (e.g., `30 days`) and ensure the select element has `aria-label="Data retention period"`.

sam (devex): yup we should add units. also thinking about defaulting: when user switches region, the retention default hint currently says `Regional defaults applied` which is vague. can we change to `Region default retention applied: 30 days`? makes it explicit.

maria (product_designer): agreed. new copy: `Region default retention applied: 30 days (you can override)`. shorter line for tooltips: `Default retention for selected region`

arjun (eng-platform): region pinning question — UI currently lets you pick region but not pin a preference. product asked for a persistent org-level preference. if we add a toggle `Make this the default region for new resources` that will add clutter. Can we hide it behind an overflow menu?

linda (security): for compliance customers we prefer an explicit, discoverable control. hide-in-menu makes audits harder to find. suggest we keep the toggle visible but mark it as an org setting with a small `?` tooltip explaining implications.

maria (product_designer): compromise: keep the toggle visible but visually lower-weight (secondary text) and add `aria-describedby` to link to the tooltip content. ethan, does that sound ok for a11y?

ethan (a11y): yes as long as the toggle is keyboard-focusable and the tooltip content is accessible via `aria-describedby`. also ensure contrast for the secondary text meets 4.5:1 for readability. current gray is too light.

ben (docs): copy for the tooltip: `Setting a default region will automatically select this region for new dedicated deployments and may affect data residency. Org admins only.`

maria (product_designer): thanks. KMS/encrypt label hierarchy next — current badge says `Encrypted` and a smaller `KMS` pill next to it. people confused whether KMS=customer-managed or platform-managed. can we change phrasing to `Encrypted — Platform key` vs `Encrypted — Customer-managed key (Bring your own key)`?

linda (security): love that. shorter forms for compact UI: `Encrypted (Platform)` and `Encrypted (BYOK)`. make sure hover/tooltip expands to full explanation and links to key ownership docs.

sam (devex): implementation note: we have two places to change — the list table and the resource details header. detail view has space for the full `Customer-managed key (BYOK)`. table should use the compact forms.

maria (product_designer): will update designs: table = `Encrypted (Platform)` / `Encrypted (BYOK)`; detail = expanded copy and a link. also add a small lock icon with `aria-hidden=true` and accessible text via the label `Encryption type: Platform-managed key` for screen readers.

ethan (a11y): perfect. ensure the link text isn't just `learn more` when it appears alone — prefer `Learn about key ownership`.

arjun (eng-platform): one more: audit log filters — currently `backup` and `retention` live in different facets; customers asked to search by change magnitude (e.g., `retention changed > 60 days`). noted as follow-up but logging it here so pm can prioritize.

maria (product_designer): added to backlog. final small copy nit: confirmation modal when changing retention currently says `Are you sure? This will change retention.` can we make it explicit: `Change retention to 90 days for workspace X. This may permanently delete messages older than the new retention period. Proceed?`

linda (security): important to mention potential deletion and link to data recovery SLA if any.

ben (docs): suggested wording for modal primary line: `Change retention to 90 days for workspace X?` secondary text: `Messages older than 90 days may be deleted permanently. Review our data lifecycle docs.`

maria (product_designer): perfect. i'll push a small patch to the mock and update the sketch file. pinging @arjun for dev feasibility and @sam for shipping checklist.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z for `compliance-panel/v2` :rocket:

arjun (eng-platform): noted — can implement copy and aria changes in the feature branch before that deploy. i'll check in with sam about analytics events for the toggle and the audit log change events.

sam (devex): i'll add unit tests for the select labels and update the i18n keys. re: translation, prefer separate keys for compact vs expanded labels so translators have context.

maria (product_designer): awesome. thanks all. i'll attach the updated artboard in the thread when ready. :seedling:
